query: KSamplerAdvanced raises AssertionError 'Input tensors must be on cuda' during Wan/LTX sampling in a workflow using MultiGPU (DisTorch2) nodes.

desired.outcome: Root cause is the MultiGPU/DisTorch2 custom node placing tensors on CPU; reverting MultiGPU commits resolved it — KJNodes innocent.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
